title: Drift Dash
description: Drift through a scrolling retro circuit and beat three AI rivals across three laps.
controls: Hold the left or right side to drift that way; release to straighten. Stay on the road and finish three laps first.

zh-CN.title: 像素漂移冲刺
zh-CN.description: 在复古竖屏赛道自动前进，按住左右侧漂移，松手回正，三圈内击败三辆AI赛车。
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕左侧向左漂移，右侧向右漂移，松手回正；跟随弯道并抢先完成三圈。
